thread:
Alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to lock in owners/timelines for an alert-tuning sweep. Main goals: reduce noise, tighten thresholds where safe, increase dedupe window for DB flaps, and formalize paging policy for transient infra alerts.

Maria: I'll take DB read errors (alerts in team-db -> rule ids db-read-err-*). Plan: raise threshold slightly and add a 5m suppression for bursts. Target: end of week.

Dmitri: I'll look at dedupe windows. Can we move dedupe from 1m -> 10m for replicated-read alerts? Need to validate we don't hide persistent failures.

Priya: I'll update the runbook and add a "quiet hours" schedule for low-priority items. Also add a checklist to validate suppression doesn't hide real regressions.

Alex: thanks. Can we add a quick smoke test? e.g., run this query against prod-like traffic and confirm no false negatives:

```
# simulate 1.5x baseline error spike
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s https://staging/api/health || echo fail; done
```

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll build a short harness and post results.

oncall-bot: created task INFR-2413 "DB alert threshold tuning" assigned to Maria, due 2026-04-01.

Dmitri: switching dedupe to 10m might mask real incidents if they persist with short gaps. Proposal: dedupe=10m but add escalation if total incidents > 3 in 1h.

Alex: agree. Let's capture that as a policy item and include it in the task.

Priya: timeline check — I can get a runbook PR up by Wed, can we sync on Thursday for rollout?

Maria: Wed EOD for threshold PR, Thurs canary rollout to staging, Fri rollout to prod with 48h monitor.

Dmitri: will schedule time Fri morning to land dedupe change after threshold rollouts.

Alex: good. Owners/timelines then: Maria (thresholds) EOW; Dmitri (dedupe policy) Fri AM; Priya (runbook + quiet hours) Thu PR; Alex to monitor and close loop. Please add a short verification note to the task when done.

SRE-ops: adding ops checklist item: "post-rollout: check token latency/500s, pages triggered, error rates baseline vs post". Template suggestion: `metrics.compare("errors", before, after)`.

Maria: noted. I'll paste canary results in the task and link dashboards.

Priya: quick question — do we want to update paging policy to always page for P0/P1 only, and suppress P2s to ticketing without paging? Anyone object?

Dmitri: no objection, agreed.

Alex: consensus then. I'll update PM and CS for visibility and close the loop with the customer-impacting alerts list.

Maria: :eyes: will drop the PR link when ready.

oncall-bot: added comment to INFR-2413: "verification checklist required before close."

Alex: thanks all. tagging @incident-review for visibility. End.
